stem:
Chirag writes the decimal sequence 0.8, 1.1, 1.4, 1.7, …

Which claim correctly extends the sequence?

options.text: Name the list a sequence and stop; naming it is enough to extend it.
The terms produce the change 0.3, so write 0.3 as the next term.
Each term is 0.3 more than the one before, so the next term is 2.0.
The next term is 1.7, because that is the last printed number in the list.

teacher.key_rationale: Common difference is +0.3, so 1.7 + 0.3 = 2.0. Naming the sequence does not extend it. The change is not itself the next term. Repeating the last printed term ignores the rule.
